title: A NULL pointer dereference flaw has been found in the vlv_value_compare() function in vlv_pagination.c of the Virtual…
description: A NULL pointer dereference vulnerability exists in the vlv_value_compare() function of the Virtual List View module in Samba. This flaw occurs when the function attempts to use a sort attribute from search results without verifying its presence. An authenticated low-privileged user can trigger LDAP worker crashes by sending Virtual List View searches sorted on attributes missing from matching entries or attributes they are not authorized to read. Repeated exploitation can cause LDAP workers to crash repeatedly, leading to denial of service by making the LDAP service unavailable. This vulnerability affects Samba versions from 4.5.0 onward. Red Hat products that ship Samba without AD DC ldb modules or do not include Samba are not affected.
